import io, numpy as np, pyarrow.parquet as pq
from PIL import Image
def conv(src, outs):
    t = pq.read_table(src)
    imgs = t.column('img').combine_chunks().field('bytes').to_pylist()
    labels = t.column('label').to_pylist()
    n = len(labels); per = n // len(outs)

        print(out, 'done')
